page.title: Upload CV
page.dropDesc: Or click to choose a file
page.formatNote: 📄 Supports PDF files with selectable text (exported from Word, Canva, Google Docs). Scanned or image-based CVs are not supported yet.

errors.invalidFileType: Please choose a valid PDF file.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file exceeds the 5MB limit. Please choose a smaller file.
errors.scannedPdf: ❌ Could not read the CV content. The file may be a scanned copy or an image. Please export your CV from Word/Canva as a PDF and upload it again.
errors.aiTemporary: The AI service is busy. Your CV has been saved and the system will retry automatically. You do not need to upload it again.
errors.aiProcessingFailed: The AI service could not process this CV. Please try again later.
errors.processingFailed: We could not finish analyzing this CV. Please try again later.
